description: Every docs page with test markup, and how often CI runs it. Priority 1: weekly. Priority 2: monthly. Priority 3: on demand only. Pushes to v0 also run priority 1 and 2 pages whose tests, watched files, or the test tooling changed (never priority 3). .github/workflows/doc-tests.yml reads this file through plan_runs.py, which also fails if a page has test markup but isn't listed. Fields: page; priority; name (artifact and report names); title (the page's name in issue and fix PR titles, for example "Getting started"); issue_label (one standing failure issue per page); watch (other files whose change should rerun the page on push, as globs, such as its example documents in assets/pdfs; the folders of the fixtures its tests use are watched automatically); timeout_minutes (the test step); ui (the page has Doc Detective UI tests, so CI installs Doc Detective); propose_fixes (on drift, open a draft PR that rewrites the documented output; fix_branch names it); envelope_issue (the page's LLM fields have regression envelopes, tracked in one standing issue labeled <issue_label>-envelope).
